sources.title: README
sources.text:
# Flask Shop
A small online shop for a course project.

Run: `pip install -r requirements.txt` then `python -m app.main`.

sources.title: 2026-10-01 — Use SQLite for development
sources.text:
**What:** SQLite in development, PostgreSQL in production.
**Why:** no setup needed for new members.

sources.title: Move payment logic into services/payment.py
sources.text: Routes were calling the payment gateway directly. Moved it into a service so routes stay thin and payment can be mocked in tests.

sources.title: Add order confirmation email
sources.text: Sends an email after checkout using services/email.py.
